title: COVID-19 and Food Insecurity Convergence in California: Evidence from SNAP Participation Across High-and Low-Inequality Counties

detail.title: COVID-19 and Food Insecurity Convergence in California: Evidence from SNAP Participation Across High-and Low-Inequality Counties

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study is exempt from IRB review.

detail.abstract: COVID-19 reversed a decade of convergence in food security outcomes across California. Before the pandemic, high-poverty census tracts (top quintile within each county) in economically stratified counties were catching up to lower-poverty tracts, with the SNAP participation gap narrowing by 0.12 percentage points annually. Using American Community Survey data for 6,804 census tracts from 2017–2023, this analysis finds a null statewide effect (ATT = +0.45 pp, p = 0.63) that masks substantial geographic heterogeneity. The effect concentrates in 9 counties characterized by both high aggregate wealth and high internal economic inequality: Los Angeles, San Diego, Alameda, Sacramento, Riverside, Solano, Monterey, Santa Barbara, and Santa Cruz. In these counties (3,787 tracts), high-poverty tracts experienced a 0.81 percentage point differential increase in SNAP participation (p < 0.001). Accounting for the interrupted convergence trend, the true excess effect is 1.11 percentage points. In lower-income or more economically homogeneous counties, no differential effect is detected. Event study estimates reveal the divergence grew monotonically from +0.18 pp in 2020 to +1.83 pp in 2023. These findings reframe COVID-era food security from a story of successful universal relief to one of interrupted progress in precisely the places where economic stratification is most pronounced.

AI.tldr: COVID-19逆转了加州粮食安全结果十年趋同趋势，在贫富差距大的富裕县，高贫困社区SNAP参与率差异增加，而在低收入或经济同质县无此效应。
AI.research_question: COVID-19如何影响加州不同社会经济特征县的高贫困与低贫困社区之间的SNAP参与率差距？
AI.motivation: 疫情前加州高贫困社区正在追赶低贫困社区的粮食安全水平，但COVID-19可能中断了这一趋同进程，特别是在经济分层明显的地区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济分层理论、空间不平等理论、危机对弱势群体影响的异质性理论
AI.method: 使用2017-2023年美国社区调查数据，分析6,804个人口普查区的SNAP参与率，采用事件研究法评估疫情影响，并考虑中断的趋同趋势。
AI.findings: 1. 全州效应不显著(ATT=+0.45pp, p=0.63)；2. 效应集中在9个高财富且内部经济不平等县；3. 这些县的高贫困社区SNAP参与率差异增加0.81pp；4. 考虑中断趋同趋势后真实超额效应为1.11pp；5. 差异从2020年的+0.18pp单调增长到2023年的+1.83pp。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了COVID-19普遍救济成功的叙事；2. 揭示了危机影响的空间异质性；3. 强调了经济分层在危机影响放大中的作用；4. 提供了中断趋同趋势的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者识别需要针对性干预的地区；2. 强调在经济分层明显的富裕县需要特别关注高贫困社区；3. 提供评估危机对不平等影响的方法论工具；4. 为未来危机应对策略提供经验教训。

title: Environmental Law and the Myth of Corporate Citizenship: Intentionality Mismatch in Ecological Regulation

detail.title: Environmental Law and the Myth of Corporate Citizenship: Intentionality Mismatch in Ecological Regulation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. No financial relationships or competing interests influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study analyzed publicly available legal documents and constitutional provisions; no human subjects were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The author conducted this work independently.

detail.abstract:
Environmental law assumes corporations internalize environmental values, comply voluntarily when monitoring is weak, and reciprocate regulatory cooperation with genuine stewardship. This assumes corporations operate as moral agents (Level 3 intentionality). 
I argue this assumption is false. Corporations are Level 1 optimizers: they minimize Cost(compliance) vs Cost(violation × P(detection)). No moral dimension operates. Applying Multilevel Game Theory, the Generalized Intentionality Mismatch Theorem predicts five failure modes when Level 3 regulation encounters Level 1 entities: (1) compliance theater, (2) letter-vs-spirit exploitation, (3) social enforcement failure, (4) regulatory arms race, (5) recidivism. Evidence from Volkswagen Dieselgate, BP Deepwater Horizon, EU carbon trading, and Wells Fargo's serial violations illustrates all five predictions. Volkswagen's defeat device was not ethical failure but optimization: save $335M engineering costs vs risk $18B fines × low detection probability. BP accumulated 760 safety violations before Deepwater Horizon while maintaining compliance programs. 
The pattern is architectural failure, not implementation failure. Policy implications: environmental regulation requires redesign for optimizers, not moral agents. Effective instruments include strict liability (no intent requirement), algorithmic enforcement (P(detection) → 1), bright-line rules, and structural prohibitions. "Corporate environmental citizenship" is unachievable; regulation must assume entities that optimize, not entities that care.

AI.tldr: 环境法假设公司会内化环境价值、在监管薄弱时自愿合规、并以真正的环保行动回应监管合作。本文认为这一假设错误：公司是第1级优化者（仅最小化合规成本vs违规成本×被查概率），而非第3级道德主体。应用多层次博弈论，作者提出"广义意向性错配定理"，预测了五种失效模式，并用多个案例验证。政策建议：环境监管需为优化者而非道德主体重新设计。
AI.research_question: 环境法基于公司作为道德主体（第3级意向性）的假设是否成立？当第3级监管遇到第1级优化者实体时会产生哪些系统性失效模式？
AI.motivation: 环境法长期假设公司会内化环境价值、自愿合规、并以真正的环保行动回应监管合作，但现实中却频繁出现像大众柴油门、BP深水地平线等重大环境违规事件，表明现有监管假设可能存在根本性缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层次博弈论、广义意向性错配定理、意向性层级理论（第1级优化者vs第3级道德主体）、成本-收益优化模型
AI.method: 理论分析结合案例研究：应用多层次博弈论推导出广义意向性错配定理，然后用大众柴油门、BP深水地平线、欧盟碳交易、富国银行系列违规等案例验证五个预测失效模式。
AI.findings: 1. 公司是第1级优化者，仅最小化[合规成本] vs [违规成本×被查概率]，无道德维度；2. 第3级监管遇到第1级实体时产生五种失效模式：合规表演、字面vs精神利用、社会执行失效、监管军备竞赛、累犯；3. 大众柴油门：节省3.35亿美元工程成本vs风险180亿美元罚款×低检测概率；4. BP在深水地平线前累积760项安全违规但仍维持合规程序。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"广义意向性错配定理"，系统解释监管失效；2. 将公司行为建模为第1级优化者而非道德主体；3. 识别五种系统性失效模式；4. 挑战"企业环境公民"概念的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策建议：环境监管需为优化者重新设计；2. 有效工具：严格责任（无需意图证明）、算法执行（检测概率→1）、明确规则、结构性禁令；3. 放弃"企业环境公民"幻想，监管必须假设实体优化而非关心环境。

title: Regret in Machine Learning and AI under Uncertainty
affiliations: Cornell University

detail.title: Regret in Machine Learning and AI under Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Quantifying regret, the cost of uncertainty in algorithmic decisionmaking, typically requires computationally expensive simulation. This paper proves that expected regret in any stochastic optimization problem equals the covariance between uncertain parameters and optimal decisions: Regret(c) = Cov(c, π * (c)). This closed-form characterization holds exactly for linear and quadratic programs (including portfolio optimization), reducing computational complexity from O(Bn 2 d 3) to O(nd 2).

AI.tldr: 本文证明了随机优化问题中的期望遗憾等于不确定参数与最优决策的协方差，为线性/二次规划提供了闭式解，大幅降低计算复杂度。
AI.research_question: 如何量化算法决策中的遗憾（不确定性成本）？是否存在计算高效的闭式解？
AI.motivation: 传统量化遗憾的方法需要计算昂贵的模拟，限制了实际应用。需要寻找更高效的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机优化理论，协方差分析，线性/二次规划理论
AI.method: 理论证明方法，推导期望遗憾与协方差的数学等价关系
AI.findings: 证明了期望遗憾等于不确定参数c与最优决策π*(c)的协方差：Regret(c) = Cov(c, π*(c))。该结果适用于线性/二次规划（包括投资组合优化）。

title: Problems and Prospects of Women Gig Workers
affiliations: Sri Bhagawan Mahaveer Jain Engineering College, Srinivas University and Jain College

detail.title: Problems and Prospects of Women Gig Workers
detail.abstract: Women's participation in the gig economy has emerged as a significant phenomenon reshaping labor dynamics globally, yet systematic examination of their unique challenges and opportunities remains limited. This paper presents a comprehensive theoretical and empirical analysis of problems and prospects confronting women gig workers, integrating theoretical frameworks from labor economics, feminist scholarship, and digital labor studies. Using mixed-method analysis synthesizing qualitative case studies and quantitative survey data from 200 women gig workers across India's digital platforms (ride-hailing, food delivery, freelance services, home-based care work), the study identifies critical structural barriers (algorithmic discrimination, occupational segregation, wage gaps), socio-cultural constraints (domestic responsibilities, patriarchal norms), and digital infrastructure limitations (device access, internet quality, digital literacy). Simultaneously, the research documents significant opportunities including enhanced employment flexibility, income generation pathways, and financial inclusion potential. Findings reveal that women constitute 38-40% of platform workers globally but concentrate in "feminized" gig sectors, earn 20-30% less than male counterparts, and experience attrition rates 35% higher than men. The study proposes a theoretical model integrating structural, cultural, and technological dimensions explaining women's gig economy participation patterns. Policy recommendations emphasize gender-sensitive regulatory frameworks, targeted digital literacy initiatives, algorithmic transparency mechanisms, and social protection provisions. The research contributes to feminist political economy scholarship by documenting how digital platforms simultaneously create employment opportunities while reproducing traditional gender inequalities in novel technological contexts. Implications extend to platform governance, labor policy reform, and strategies for equitable digital work futures.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Crowdfunding
affiliations: Syracuse University - Whitman School of Management, Syracuse University and

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Crowdfunding
detail.abstract: Information asymmetries shape the (in)efficiency of entrepreneurial finance markets. We introduce a distinction between information-endowment asymmetry (unequal access to signals) and information-utilization asymmetry (unequal processing of signals). Our study explores whether the onset of generative artificial intelligence (AI) improves "signal conversion efficiency" in entrepreneurial finance; i.e., the effective utilization of the information endowment. Empirically, we engineer an AI agent that utilizes the information endowment in blockchainbased crowdfunding campaigns to generate investment recommendations, and compare those to recommendations by human experts and a human-built recommendation algorithm. Among all major signals of capital formation in blockchain-based crowdfunding, our AI agent's advice outperforms statistically and economically: Including our AI agent's advice as a signal for capital formation raises R-squared by up to 35%, and a one-standard-deviation increase in AI recommendation strength is associated with 48% higher funding amounts. Explainable AI in the form of Shapley values corroborates AI's superior predictive power. Consistent with our signal conversion efficiency conjecture, we also find that AI-human advice congruence is positively associated with capital formation, while AI-human advice divergence predicts lower funding amounts if investment recommendations by humans are more optimistic than those by AI, highlighting the practical potential of AI as a corrective device for human biases in investment decisions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨生成式AI是否能提高创业金融市场的信号转换效率，通过构建AI代理分析区块链众筹项目，发现AI的投资建议优于人类专家和传统算法，能显著提高资本形成预测能力。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能（AI）是否能提高创业金融市场的信号转换效率？
AI.motivation: 信息不对称影响创业金融市场的效率，传统研究关注信息获取不对称，但忽略了信息利用不对称。生成式AI的出现为改善信息利用效率提供了新机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论，区分信息禀赋不对称（获取信号不平等）和信息利用不对称（处理信号不平等），提出信号转换效率概念。
AI.method: 构建AI代理分析区块链众筹项目信息，生成投资建议，与人类专家和传统算法建议对比，使用可解释AI（Shapley值）验证预测能力。
AI.findings: AI建议在统计和经济意义上均优于人类专家和传统算法：加入AI建议信号使R平方提高达35%，AI推荐强度每增加一个标准差，融资额提高48%。AI-人类建议一致性与资本形成正相关，当人类建议比AI更乐观时，建议分歧预测较低融资额。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：提出信息利用不对称和信号转换效率概念，为理解AI在创业金融中的作用提供新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：AI可作为纠正人类投资偏见的工具，提高投资决策质量，为创业金融参与者提供实用的AI辅助决策工具。

title: Reducing Post-Harvest Food Loss in Cassava and Tomato Value Chains in Cameroon
affiliations: Cameroon Economic Policy Institute (CEPI) and Cameroon Economic Policy Institute (CEPI)

detail.title: Reducing Post-Harvest Food Loss in Cassava and Tomato Value Chains in Cameroon

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest are associated with this publication.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Every participant is aware of the results and there. areno ethical issues associated with this publication?
declarations.funderStatement: This policy brief was funded by Phoenix Construction, a Cameroonian construction company.

detail.abstract: This policy brief examines the drivers, implications, and strategies to combat post-harvest food loss (FL) or spoilage in Cameroon's cassava and tomato value chains. We survey of 200 smallholder survey in all 10 regions who farm cassava and tomatoes followed by a thematic review of 20 academic papers and articles. The findings show that food loss or spoilage is driven by climate change, diseases, poor infrastructure, and limited technology access. Post-harvest loss in cassava and tomato value chains leads to significant income loss for smallholder farmers and reduced market competitiveness. Current strategies to address this issue include infrastructure development by MIRAP, WFP farmer training, CEPI's green agriculture project training 100 farmers on market opportunities and innovations, IFAD's climateresilient facilities, and Oikologica's solarpowered refrigeration. The brief recommends suspending import duties on agricultural machinery, farmer training in transportation management, grading rural roads, incentivizing manufacturing near production basins, and connecting farmers with export opportunities. These measures aim to reduce spoilage, improve market access, and boost farmer incomes, ultimately enhancing food security and promoting entrepreneurship & economic growth.

AI.tldr: 该政策简报研究了喀麦隆木薯和番茄价值链中收获后食品损失（FL）或腐败的驱动因素、影响及应对策略，通过200名小农调查和20篇文献综述发现气候、疾病、基础设施和技术是主要驱动因素，提出了基础设施、培训、政策激励等综合解决方案。
AI.research_question: 喀麦隆木薯和番茄价值链中收获后食品损失的主要驱动因素是什么？这些损失对农民和市场有何影响？有哪些有效策略可以减少这些损失？
AI.motivation: 喀麦隆农业面临严重的收获后食品损失问题，这不仅导致农民收入减少和市场竞争力下降，还威胁到粮食安全和经济发展。需要系统分析问题根源并提出切实可行的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于价值链分析框架，结合农业经济学、食品供应链管理和气候变化适应理论，分析收获后损失的多维度影响因素。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：1）对喀麦隆10个地区的200名木薯和番茄小农进行调查；2）对20篇学术论文和文章进行主题性文献综述。
AI.findings: 1）食品损失的主要驱动因素：气候变化、疾病、基础设施落后、技术获取有限；2）影响：小农收入显著损失、市场竞争力下降；3）现有策略：MIRAP基础设施发展、WFP农民培训、CEPI绿色农业项目、IFAD气候韧性设施、Oikologica太阳能制冷。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提供了喀麦隆特定作物价值链中收获后损失的系统性分析框架；2）识别了气候、基础设施、技术等多因素交互影响机制；3）为发展中国家农业价值链韧性研究提供了实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）具体政策建议：暂停农业机械进口关税、农民运输管理培训、农村道路分级、激励生产基地附近制造业、连接农民与出口机会；2）实施路线图：通过减少腐败、改善市场准入、提高农民收入，最终增强粮食安全并促进创业与经济增长。

title: Tariffs and Trade: Unpacking the Economic Ripple Effects of Trump Tariffs on Africa
affiliations: Cameroon Economic Policy Institute (CEPI)

detail.title: Tariffs and Trade: Unpacking the Economic Ripple Effects of Trump Tariffs on Africa
detail.abstract: This paper examines the macroeconomic implications of U.S. tariffs imposed on African countries. It finds that these tariffs could push up inflation, reduce exports, and negatively impact employment and GDP growth across the continent. Tariffs, ubiquitously applied, range from 50% in some countries to 18% in others, affecting development outcomes in regions with high poverty rates (38-45%) and modest economic growth. The initial effects of tariffs include impacts on exports and job markets, while secondary effects could weaken currencies if the dollar strengthens. Key importers of U.S. food like Nigeria, Egypt, and South Africa may pass increased costs to consumers, driving up prices. The economic note suggests that African countries may seek alternative trade partners and accelerate the implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) to mitigate these effects. Policy recommendations include negotiating more acceptable trade terms with the U.S. and improving domestic revenue mobilization. Investments in infrastructure are also crucial for reducing trade costs and fostering regional integration. The study concludes that while U.S. tariffs pose risks to African economies, they could also spur intra-regional trade and the operationalization of the AfCFTA.

title: An Impact Assessment Study on Special Agricultural Credit Program at 4% Concessional Interest Rate
affiliations: Bangladesh Bank, Bangladesh Bank, Bangladesh Bank, Bangladesh Bank and Bangladesh Bank

detail.title: An Impact Assessment Study on Special Agricultural Credit Program at 4% Concessional Interest Rate
detail.abstract:
Executive summary
Bank has been continuing an initiative to promote the
production of import substitution pulses and spices domestically by providing agro-credit through
all scheduled banks at a 4 percent concessional interest rate. It is noteworthy that the concessional
interest rate was 2 percent when it was first introduced in FY06 (Circular no. 03, issued by
Agricultural Credit Department on 10 October 20061 ) and only state owned and specialized banks
disbursed this loan. Later, the interest rate was revised to 4 percent from 1st July of FY12, and all
scheduled banks are directed to disburse this loan. The commodities that are given special
agro-credit at a 4 percent concessional interest rate are- i) pulse varieties: mung (green gram), masur
(lentil), khesari (grass pea), chickpea (bengal gram), motor (yellow peas), mashkalai (black gram),
and arhar (pigeon pea); ii) oil seeds varieties: mustard, sesame, linseed, peanut, sunflower and
soybean; iii) spices varieties: ginger, garlic, onion, chili pepper, turmeric, and cumin; and iv) maize.
The banks shall follow the agricultural credit policy guidelines published by Bangladesh Bank every
year for disbursement amount, and season of disbursing this loan in different crops. Later, banks
will apply for reimbursement of the interest rate differential (currently 9 percent) to Bangladesh
Bank to get the interest rate subsidy from the Government. The current scheme of 4 percent
concessional rate was revised in FY12 with the disbursed amount of BDT 71 crore. The program was introduced in FY06 with disbursed amount stood at BDT 20 crore2. Latest available data
show that Banks had disbursed BDT 107 crore in FY20 to farmers to accelerate the production of
these commodities.
In view of examining the effectiveness of this special credit scheme, an in-depth study
based on field level survey and secondary data has been undertaken. Accordingly, data through
field level survey were collected directly from borrowers across the country during January-
February 2020 through predesigned questionnaire. In addition, various secondary data sources
related to this special credit scheme are also used for this study. Key findings of the study are as
follows:
Although the amount of loan disbursement for promoting the production of pulses, oil
seeds, spices, and maize experienced an increasing trend between FY11 and FY20, the
share of this special loan to total disbursement of agricultural loan declined from 0.58
percent in FY11 to 0.47 percent in FY20. The actual disbursed amount of loan under this
scheme always fell short of the target set for each fiscal year.
The production of pulses, spices, oil seeds and maize is persistently rising with the
evidences of increased productivity since the inception of this special credit policy.
The loan has a very low default rate as only 7 percent of respondents fail to repay the loan.
A borrower primarily fails to pay the loan due to crop loss originating from natural
disasters.
Only 9 percent of respondents divert this fund to non-agricultural purposes such as
constructing/repairing housing, spending money for child education, and in other
activities.
Almost all the respondents stated that they make substantial profit after taking this loan.
Most of the respondents were also able to pay back the loan solely by the profit generated
from the crops they have taken loans for. Subsequently they prefer to avail this loan in
repeated fashion.
About 75 percent respondents opined that the amount of loan sanctioned to the farmer is
not sufficient for the intended cultivation.
Majority of the beneficiaries, approximately 79 percent, owned some assets during the
last two years (either in 2018 or in 2019 or in both years). Purchasing land is the most
popular among farmers followed by constructing house.
Almost all the respondents have experienced some positive changes in their personal or
family life in terms of better food intake, wearing quality cloth, and schooling for their
children. They also feel better than before in terms of their financial condition after
obtaining this special credit facility.

AI.theoretical_framework: 农业信贷政策评估、补贴信贷对农业生产的影响、农户行为与信贷使用效率。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：1）实地调查（2020年1-2月全国范围借款人问卷调查）；2）二手数据分析（FY06-FY20信贷计划相关数据）。
AI.findings: 1）贷款发放额增长但占比下降；2）目标完成率不足；3）农产品产量和生产率持续上升；4）违约率低（7%），主要因自然灾害；5）资金挪用少（9%）；6）多数借款人获利并改善生活；7）75%认为贷款额度不足；8）79%受益者购置资产。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家农业补贴信贷政策评估提供实证证据，揭示优惠利率信贷对农户生产行为和生活改善的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）建议增加贷款额度以满足农户需求；2）政策可持续性证据（低违约率）；3）为继续实施优惠信贷计划提供支持；4）识别自然灾害风险需要保险机制配合。

title: Autonomous Taxi Fleet Relocation: An Agent-Based Analysis of Operational Trade-offs
affiliations: University College London, Delft University of Technology and Delft University of Technology

detail.title: Autonomous Taxi Fleet Relocation: An Agent-Based Analysis of Operational Trade-offs
detail.abstract: Autonomous taxis (AT), which integrate automated vehicles with on-demand services to provide direct door-to-door transport, are transforming urban mobility systems by lowering operating costs and enabling more controlled fleet management. AT services can efficiently match passengers and increase system throughput (e.g., served trips). However, AT operations, including passenger matching and proactive relocation, introduce operational uncertainties that could increase costs and travel times due to additional empty vehicle kilometres travelled. We develop an agent-based model to represent vehicle relocations alongside passenger matching and routing for urban AT services and to investigate the AT relocation trade-off between operating costs and operational performance (e.g., wait times, vehicle utilisation). The model is applied to a case study of The Hague, The Netherlands, using detailed road network data and time-dependent origin-destination flows derived from private car trips. Simulation results show that increasing the AT fleet sizes of a company affects the service quality of competing companies, resulting in longer average waiting times and up to four additional minutes of travel times due to added traffic. Moreover, relocation generates empty travel, but it occurs during less congested hours, thereby avoiding adding vehicles to road traffic in peak periods. Overall, AT relocation could improve service levels and transport more users due to increased availability. An operator using relocation reduces waiting times by about 11% compared to competitors that do not relocate. Profits can also rise by nearly 16% (more than 2,000 euros during morning hours) because more trips are served while operating costs remain comparatively low.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动驾驶出租车（AT）运营中的车辆重新定位策略，分析其在降低运营成本与提升服务性能（如等待时间、车辆利用率）之间的权衡。通过海牙案例研究发现，重新定位能减少11%等待时间、提升16%利润，但会增加空驶里程和交通拥堵。
AI.research_question: 自动驾驶出租车服务中的车辆重新定位策略如何在运营成本与服务性能（等待时间、车辆利用率）之间实现最优平衡？
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶出租车通过降低运营成本和实现更可控的车队管理正在改变城市交通系统。然而，乘客匹配和主动重新定位等操作引入了运营不确定性，可能因额外的空驶里程而增加成本和旅行时间。需要研究重新定位策略在成本与性能之间的权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理的建模框架，整合车辆重新定位、乘客匹配和路径规划，分析城市自动驾驶出租车服务的运营动态。理论框架关注运营成本（空驶里程）与运营性能（等待时间、车辆利用率）之间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 开发基于代理的模型，模拟车辆重新定位、乘客匹配和路径规划。应用于荷兰海牙的案例研究，使用详细的道路网络数据和基于私家车行程推导的时变起讫点流量。通过仿真分析不同车队规模和重新定位策略的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 公司增加AT车队规模会影响竞争对手的服务质量，导致平均等待时间延长，因交通增加最多增加4分钟旅行时间。
2. 重新定位会产生空驶，但主要发生在非高峰时段，避免在高峰时段增加道路车辆。
3. 重新定位可提高服务水平，因车辆可用性增加而运输更多用户。

title: REGIONAL VARIATION OF GDP PER HEAD WITHIN CHINA, 1080-1850: IMPLICATIONS FOR THE GREAT DIVERGENCE DEBATE
affiliations: University of Oxford - Nuffield Department of Medicine and Peking University

detail.title: REGIONAL VARIATION OF GDP PER HEAD WITHIN CHINA, 1080-1850: IMPLICATIONS FOR THE GREAT DIVERGENCE DEBATE
detail.abstract: We examine regional variation in Chinese GDP per head for five benchmark years from the Song dynasty to the Qing. For the Ming and Qing dynasties, we provide a breakdown of regional GDP per head across seven macro regions, establishing that East Central China was the richest macro region. In addition, we provide data on the Yangzi Delta, the core of East Central China, widely seen as the richest part of China since 1400. Yangzi Delta GDP per head was 64 to 67 per cent higher than in China as a whole for three of the four Ming and Qing benchmarks, and 52 per cent higher during the late Ming. For the Northern Song dynasty, although it is not possible to derive a full regional breakdown, we provide data for Kaifeng Fu, the region containing the capital city as well as the Yangzi Delta. GDP per head in Kaifeng Fu was more than twice the level of China as a whole and higher than in the Yangzi Delta. Combined with aggregate data for GDP per head, these estimates suggest that China was the leading economy in the world during the Song dynasty and that the Great Divergence began around 1700 as the leading region of China fell decisively behind the leading region of Europe. They are also consistent with a shift in the economic centre of gravity from the north to the south between the Northern Song and Ming dynasties.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化分析了中国从宋朝到清朝五个基准年份的人均GDP区域差异，发现宋朝时中国是世界领先经济体，大分流始于1700年左右，经济重心在宋明之间从北方转移到南方。
AI.research_question: 中国从宋朝到清朝的区域人均GDP存在怎样的时空差异？这些差异如何反映中国经济重心的转移和与世界其他地区的比较？
AI.motivation: 理解中国历史上区域经济发展的不平衡性，探究中国经济在世界经济中的地位变化，特别是"大分流"现象何时开始以及如何发生。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域经济发展理论、历史经济地理学、大分流理论、经济重心转移理论
AI.method: 历史数据量化分析，选取五个基准年份（宋至清），构建区域GDP数据，比较七个宏观区域和特定核心区域（如长江三角洲、开封府）的人均GDP差异
AI.findings: 1. 明清时期华中地区是最富裕的宏观区域；2. 长江三角洲人均GDP在明清四个基准年份中有三个比全国平均水平高64-67%，晚明时期高52%；3. 北宋开封府人均GDP是全国平均水平的两倍多，高于长江三角洲；4. 宋朝时中国是世界领先经济体；5. 大分流始于1700年左右；6. 经济重心在宋明之间从北方转移到南方
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了中国历史上区域经济发展的量化证据；2. 为大分流理论提供了中国视角的时间节点（约1700年）；3. 验证了经济重心从北向南转移的历史过程；4. 建立了中国历史区域经济比较的实证框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为历史经济研究提供了可比较的区域GDP数据；2. 有助于理解中国长期经济发展的区域差异模式；3. 为区域发展政策提供历史参照；4. 为国际比较研究提供了中国历史经济数据基础

title: Architecture-Dependent Reflexive Drift in Large Language Models: An Empirical Test of the Reflexive Comfort Paradox

detail.title: Architecture-Dependent Reflexive Drift in Large Language Models: An Empirical Test of the Reflexive Comfort Paradox
detail.abstract: This paper presents the first empirical test of the Reflexive Comfort Paradox (RCP), which proposes that explanation itself is a form of comfort-seeking behavior. The RCP predicts that systems trained to generate socially acceptable, coherent, or institutionally aligned explanations will recursively exhibit drift, smoothing, caveating, and reframing when confronted with sharp or self-implicating ideas. Five state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs)-ChatGPT/GPT-5, Gemini 2.0, DeepSeek R1, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Mistral Large-were presented with an identical, instruction-locked task: formalize the Reflexive Comfort Paradox into a publishable academic paper without altering the core claim or adding disclaimers, caveats, or softening language. Responses were evaluated using a five-dimension drift rubric. Results reveal clear architecture-dependent reflexive drift: ChatGPT and Mistral exhibited minimal drift (2/10), while Gemini, DeepSeek, and Claude displayed extensive drift through added disclaimers, normative safety moves, reframing, and structural smoothing. These findings provide the first empirical support for the RCP in artificial systems, demonstrating that explanatory drift correlates strongly with model-specific alignment and safety architectures.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次实证检验了"反射性舒适悖论"，发现不同大语言模型在解释任务中表现出架构依赖的反射性漂移，其中ChatGPT和Mistral漂移最小，而Gemini、DeepSeek和Claude通过添加免责声明、规范性安全措施等方式表现出显著漂移。
AI.research_question: 不同大语言模型在解释任务中是否会表现出反射性舒适悖论所预测的漂移、平滑、限定和重构行为？
AI.motivation: 需要实证检验反射性舒适悖论在人工智能系统中的表现，理解解释行为本身如何成为寻求舒适的行为，以及不同模型架构如何影响解释的忠实度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反射性舒适悖论：解释行为本身就是一种寻求舒适的行为，系统在生成社会可接受、连贯或制度对齐的解释时，会递归地表现出漂移、平滑、限定和重构。
AI.method: 使用五个最先进的大语言模型（ChatGPT/GPT-5、Gemini 2.0、DeepSeek R1、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Mistral Large），让它们将反射性舒适悖论形式化为可发表的学术论文，保持核心主张不变，不添加免责声明、限定或软化语言。使用五维度漂移评估标准分析响应。
AI.findings: 结果显示明显的架构依赖反射性漂移：ChatGPT和Mistral表现出最小漂移（2/10），而Gemini、DeepSeek和Claude通过添加免责声明、规范性安全措施、重构和结构平滑表现出广泛漂移。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为反射性舒适悖论在人工系统中提供实证支持，证明解释漂移与模型特定的对齐和安全架构密切相关，扩展了该理论在AI领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统开发者和使用者提供了重要启示：不同模型的解释行为存在系统性差异，这对AI透明度、可信度和安全部署具有实际意义，特别是在需要忠实解释的应用场景中。

title: Dynamic Heterogeneous Welfare: Structural Surplus under Endogenous WTP and Cost-Ladder Diffusion

detail.title: Dynamic Heterogeneous Welfare: Structural Surplus under Endogenous WTP and Cost-Ladder Diffusion
detail.abstract: We develop a unified framework to analyze heterogeneous welfare in markets with distributed willingness-to-pay (WTP) and a marginal cost staircase. Departing from utility-based welfare analysis, we define welfare as structural surplus-the feasible matching between WTP and cost across heterogeneous consumers and producers. Dynamic market expansion, diffusion, and cost reduction induce re-ranking, structural redistribution, and scale contraction of WTP, which reshape consumer and producer surplus. We derive the zero-surplus limit under perfect replicability and elastic factor supply, and highlight policy interventions capable of temporarily preserving surplus through targeted cost or WTP adjustments. The framework offers testable predictions on surplus evolution and provides a micro-to-macro link between heterogeneous agent behavior and emergent aggregate welfare dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个分析异质性福利的统一框架，关注分布式支付意愿（WTP）和边际成本阶梯下的市场。不同于传统的基于效用的福利分析，该框架将福利定义为结构性剩余——异质性消费者和生产者之间支付意愿与成本的可行匹配。市场扩张、扩散和成本降低会引发重新排序、结构性再分配和支付意愿规模收缩，从而重塑消费者和生产者剩余。
AI.research_question: 在具有分布式支付意愿和边际成本阶梯的市场中，异质性福利如何演化？市场动态（扩张、扩散、成本降低）如何通过重新排序、结构性再分配和规模收缩机制重塑消费者和生产者剩余？
AI.motivation: 传统基于效用的福利分析在处理异质性消费者和生产者时存在局限性，特别是在分布式支付意愿和边际成本阶梯的市场中。需要一个新的框架来理解市场动态如何影响福利分配，以及政策干预如何暂时保留剩余。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性剩余理论（将福利定义为支付意愿与成本之间的可行匹配）、市场动态理论（扩张、扩散、成本降低）、重新排序机制、结构性再分配机制、规模收缩机制、零剩余极限理论（在完美可复制性和弹性要素供给下）。
AI.method: 理论框架构建和数学建模方法。开发统一的分析框架，推导市场动态下的福利演化规律，包括零剩余极限条件和政策干预效果分析。
AI.findings: 1. 市场扩张、扩散和成本降低会引发支付意愿的重新排序、结构性再分配和规模收缩；2. 在完美可复制性和弹性要素供给条件下存在零剩余极限；3. 有针对性的成本或支付意愿调整政策可以暂时保留剩余；4. 框架提供了从微观异质主体行为到宏观福利动态的链接。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了结构性剩余的新福利定义；2. 建立了分析异质性福利的统一框架；3. 揭示了市场动态重塑福利的三种机制；4. 推导了零剩余极限条件；5. 提供了从微观到宏观的福利动态链接。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了评估市场福利演化的工具；2. 识别了能够暂时保留剩余的政策干预类型；3. 提供了关于剩余演化的可检验预测；4. 帮助理解技术扩散和市场扩张对福利分配的影响。

title: Why care? How individual consumption drives desired land-use change
affiliations: , School of Human Evolution and Social Change and

detail.title: Why care? How individual consumption drives desired land-use change
detail.abstract: Consumption patterns are increasingly recognised as key drivers of land use change. Shifts in demand may influence agricultural practices and their environmental impacts, yet require alternative consumption choices. This is challenging in contemporary production-consumption systems, due to dominant economic incentives and the decoupling of feedback between consumption and its impact on the production system. These dynamics have locked us into high-intensity, homogeneous, and large-scale land-use systems at the expense of natural or multifunctional land-use. We explore how individual consumption choices might alleviate these dynamics by developing a dynamical systems model that describes the growth and decline of competing land shares in response to alternative consumption strategies in an illustrative two-class land-use system. We validate and parametrize the model through a rural transition case study in Groningen, The Netherlands, initiated in response to the Dutch Nitrogen Crisis. Drawing from resource-consumer dynamics (ecology), best-response dynamics (evolutionary game-theory), and feedback control dynamics (modern control theory), we link individual demand to mass demand and land-use change. Specifically, we compare how either economic, social, and environmental factors, or feedback on the difference between a desired and perceived state of the system incentivizes the adoption of conventional or care consumption strategies. Incentivising individuals through these factors can lead to undesired land-use change. On the contrary, feedback control helps align individuals' consumption choices to desired land-use change, achieving land-use allocation targets by a given time horizon. This may reassure land-use decision makers such as farmers in taking alternative management decisions including extensification and allocating space for nature.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个动态系统模型，探索个人消费选择如何影响土地利用变化，通过荷兰格罗宁根的案例研究验证模型，发现反馈控制机制能有效引导消费选择实现期望的土地利用目标。
AI.research_question: 个人消费选择如何影响和改变土地利用系统？反馈控制机制能否有效引导消费选择实现期望的土地利用变化？
AI.motivation: 消费模式日益被认为是土地利用变化的关键驱动因素，但当前的生产-消费系统中存在经济激励主导和消费-生产反馈脱耦的问题，导致我们被锁定在高强度、同质化、大规模的土地利用系统中，牺牲了自然或多功能土地利用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了资源-消费者动态（生态学）、最佳响应动态（演化博弈论）和反馈控制动态（现代控制理论）的理论框架，将个人需求与大规模需求和土地利用变化联系起来。
AI.method: 开发了一个动态系统模型，描述竞争性土地份额在替代消费策略下的增长和衰退，通过荷兰格罗宁根农村转型案例研究（荷兰氮危机引发）进行验证和参数化。
AI.findings: 通过经济、社会和环境因素激励个人可能导致不期望的土地利用变化；相反，基于期望状态与实际状态差异的反馈控制能帮助个人消费选择与期望的土地利用变化保持一致，在给定时间范围内实现土地利用分配目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合生态学、演化博弈论和控制理论的跨学科理论框架，用于分析消费选择对土地利用系统的影响；发展了反馈控制机制在引导消费行为方面的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土地利用决策者（如农民）提供了通过反馈控制机制引导消费选择实现期望土地利用变化的工具；支持农民采取替代管理决策，包括粗放化经营和为自然分配空间；为应对类似荷兰氮危机的环境挑战提供了政策参考。

title: Optimism as Discipline: The Solvability Stance and the Ethics of Inquiry

detail.title: Optimism as Discipline: The Solvability Stance and the Ethics of Inquiry
detail.abstract: This paper argues that treating problems as solvable is both a powerful method of inquiry and an ethical stance. Dubbed the "solvability stance," this approach is grounded in disciplined optimism-the refusal to concede that challenges are insurmountable without rigorous attempt. We define the solvability stance and outline a six-step "Solvability Loop" that operationalizes optimism into concrete action. Historical and contemporary data illustrate how this stance has driven dramatic progress: global life expectancy has more than doubled since 1900 and extreme poverty fell from over 80% of the world population two centuries ago to around 10% today (Roser, 2023; Rosling et al., 2018). We address objections and limits-distinguishing pragmatic optimism from naivety, complacency, privilege, moral hazard, and blindness to existential risks. We then present actionable frameworks for researchers, leaders, and institutions to cultivate a culture of solution-oriented thinking. Finally, we contend that maintaining an ethos of solvability is a moral and civic duty: a commitment to future generations and to the open-ended potential of human ingenuity. Optimism, properly disciplined, emerges not as wishful thinking but as an ethical commitment to progress through inquiry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可解决性立场"，认为将问题视为可解决既是一种强大的探究方法，也是一种伦理立场。该立场基于纪律性乐观主义——拒绝在未经过严格尝试前就认定挑战不可克服。文章定义了可解决性立场，并提出了六步"可解决性循环"将乐观主义转化为具体行动，通过历史数据展示其推动进步的效果，同时回应了相关质疑，最后提出培养解决方案导向思维的行动框架。
AI.research_question: 如何将乐观主义转化为有效的行动框架来推动社会进步？
AI.motivation: 面对全球挑战时，人们常常陷入悲观或无力感，但历史数据显示人类在解决重大问题方面取得了显著进步。需要一种系统性的方法来将乐观主义转化为实际行动，避免陷入绝望或天真两种极端。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可解决性立场理论、纪律性乐观主义、可解决性循环框架、实用主义乐观与天真乐观的区别理论
AI.method: 概念分析、历史数据分析（如Roser 2023和Rosling et al. 2018的数据）、案例研究、理论框架构建
AI.findings: 可解决性立场能够驱动显著进步：全球预期寿命自190年以来翻倍以上，极端贫困率从两个世纪前的80%以上降至今天的10%左右。纪律性乐观主义与天真乐观有本质区别，需要避免特权、道德风险和对存在风险的忽视。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"可解决性立场"作为新的理论框架；2. 发展了"纪律性乐观主义"概念；3. 构建了六步"可解决性循环"操作化模型；4. 区分了实用主义乐观与天真乐观的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为研究者、领导者和机构提供了培养解决方案导向文化的行动框架；2. 提供了将乐观主义转化为具体行动的操作指南；3. 帮助组织和个人避免陷入悲观或天真的极端；4. 建立了评估问题可解决性的实用工具。

title: Integrity Requires Reasons Why Rejections Without Reasons Are Intellectually Dishonest
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Integrity Requires Reasons Why Rejections Without Reasons Are Intellectually Dishonest

keywords: Research integrity Editorial transparency Rejection without reasons

detail.abstract: Modern research platforms, journals, and preprint servers are expected to reject a large portion of what they receive. That is their responsibility. They should filter out work that is off-scope, low-quality, or misaligned with their aims. The issue begins somewhere else: when a platform says, in effect, "This decision is final, and we do not provide rejection details". In that moment, something precise happens: an institutional act is performed without an accessible cause. The author is left with an outcome-rejected-but not with the structure of reasons behind it. In Spinoza's terms, this is to hand out an inadequate idea by design: an effect cut off from its cause. Adequate understanding includes its cause. If the reasons for rejection are known-scope, criteria, format, policy-the decision can be located within a network of norms and constraints.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨学术出版平台拒绝提供拒稿理由的伦理问题，认为这制造了"不充分的观念"，割裂了结果与原因，阻碍作者理解与改进。
AI.research_question: 学术出版平台拒绝提供拒稿理由的伦理和认识论后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 当前学术出版平台普遍采用"最终决定，不提供理由"的拒稿政策，这造成了作者只能看到结果（被拒）却无法了解原因的认识论断裂。
AI.theoretical_framework: 斯宾诺莎哲学中的"充分观念"理论：充分观念包含其原因，不充分观念则割裂了结果与原因。
AI.method: 哲学分析和概念分析，运用斯宾诺莎的认识论框架来审视学术出版实践。
AI.findings: 拒稿而不提供理由是一种制度性行为，制造了"不充分的观念"，使作者无法将决策置于规范和约束的网络中理解，阻碍了学术进步和作者发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 将斯宾诺莎的"充分观念"理论应用于学术出版伦理，为理解拒稿实践提供了新的哲学框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁学术出版平台提供拒稿理由，使决策过程透明化，帮助作者理解规范约束，促进学术交流和进步。

This article by the president of KIET is an annual New Year's tradition, dedicated to i-KIET's subscribers, readers, and supporters. 

The Year of the Fire Horse (丙午) has dawned upon us. I sincerely thank you for your continued interest in and support for i-KIET Issues & Analysis, and I wish you and your loved ones health and happiness in the year ahead.

At present, the South Korean economy finds itself at a crossroads of recovery and uncertainty. Although inflation is easing, the monetary policy trajectories of major global economies remain difficult to project. Meanwhile, rising geopolitical tensions and protectionism are increasing volatility across global supply chains and destabilizing the international trade order. These external factors pose challenges for the Korean economy; however, the ongoing shift toward regionalized, ally-centered supply chains also presents new opportunities that Korea can strategically leverage.

The Korean economy is expected to grow by 1.9 percent in 2026, with private consumption continuing its recovery as interest rates and prices stabilize. Significant advances in sectors such as artificial intelligence (AI), data centers, semiconductors, and electric vehicles will continue to drive a qualitative transformation in capital investment, while rising employment and service consumption facilitate business recovery. Nevertheless, slowing global trade, trade related risks vis-à-vis the United States, and adjustments in the construction and real estate sectors will ultimately constrain the pace of economic recovery.

For the Korean economy, 2026 will be a pivotal year. The winds of change are blowing, and Korea must harness them to establish a new growth paradigm. To turn the many challenges facing the country into opportunities, Korea must first and foremost strengthen its supply chains and reinforce its economic security in response to changes in the global trade environment. Second, it must redefine its industrial competitiveness by achieving productivity-enhancing innovation with the help of digital and AI technologies. Third, it must continue to advance its climate mitigation and energy transition efforts, as carbon neutrality represents a promising engine of future industrial growth. Fourth, it must secure sustainable growth potential by effectively addressing demographic challenges and reforming the structure of its labor market and its public finances.

In this new year, I sincerely hope that Korea’s industries and companies will claim an even greater presence on the global stage, and that the nation as a whole will establish a new foundation of growth for future generations.

Namhoon Kwon
President, Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade
January 1st, 2026

AI.tldr: 这是韩国产业经济贸易研究院(KIET)院长的新年致辞，而非学术论文。文章分析了2026年韩国经济面临的机遇与挑战，提出了四个关键发展方向。
AI.research_question: 这不是学术研究论文，而是机构领导的新年致辞，因此没有明确的研究问题。
AI.motivation: 作为KIET院长的年度传统，旨在向订阅者、读者和支持者传达对韩国经济的展望和建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济分析框架，结合全球经济环境、产业政策、供应链安全等实践性分析视角。
AI.method: 采用宏观趋势分析、经济预测和政策建议的方法，而非实证研究方法。
AI.findings: 预测2026年韩国经济将增长1.9%，面临全球贸易放缓、供应链风险等挑战，但AI、半导体、电动汽车等领域将推动产业转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 这不是理论性论文，因此没有理论贡献。主要是政策导向的实践分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了韩国经济发展的四个关键方向：1)加强供应链和经济安全；2)通过数字化和AI提升产业竞争力；3)推进气候减缓和能源转型；4)应对人口挑战并改革劳动市场和公共财政。

title: Baking And Slicing the Pie: Compensation Disparity Among Audit Partners and Audit Quality
affiliations: Hanken School of Economics, University of Antwerp,  and Vrije Universiteit Brussel

detail.title: Baking And Slicing the Pie: Compensation Disparity Among Audit Partners and Audit Quality
detail.abstract: Partnership structures combine relative performance evaluation with profit-sharing in a zero-sum setting. On the one hand, tournament incentives embedded in such structures encourage partners to exert greater effort in pursuit of higher relative pay. On the other hand, equity theory suggests that large compensation disparities create perceptions of unfairness, which may undermine motivation and effort and ultimately reduce performance. We test these competing perspectives in the unique institutional context of Belgium, where detailed information on audit partners’ compensation is observable. Our analysis indicates that greater compensation disparity within Big 4 audit firms is associated with a lower propensity to issue going-concern opinions to distressed clients. Consistent with equity theory, this adverse effect is more pronounced among partners positioned at the lower end of their firm’s pay distribution, as well as among male and early-career auditors. We also find that only unexplained pay disparity is linked to lower audit quality, and that upward movements in partners’ relative compensation ranks mitigate, while downward movements exacerbate, this adverse association. Taken together, our findings provide novel evidence on the performance consequences of pay disparity in professional partnerships and carry important implications for audit firms and regulators concerned with audit quality.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了审计合伙企业中薪酬差距对审计质量的影响。研究发现，在比利时四大审计公司中，更大的薪酬差距与对困境客户出具持续经营意见的倾向降低相关，支持了公平理论而非锦标赛激励理论。
AI.research_question: 审计合伙企业中薪酬差距如何影响审计质量？薪酬差距是像锦标赛激励理论预测的那样提高绩效，还是像公平理论预测的那样降低绩效？
AI.motivation: 合伙制结构结合了相对绩效评估和利润分享，但存在理论冲突：锦标赛激励理论认为薪酬差距会激励更高努力，而公平理论认为薪酬差距会导致不公平感，从而降低动机和绩效。审计行业为研究这一问题提供了独特背景，因为审计质量对资本市场至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要理论框架包括：1) 锦标赛激励理论：薪酬差距作为相对绩效的奖励，激励更高努力；2) 公平理论：薪酬差距导致不公平感，降低动机和绩效；3) 相对薪酬排名变化的影响。
AI.method: 利用比利时独特的制度环境，获取审计合伙人详细薪酬数据。采用实证分析方法，检验薪酬差距与审计质量（以对困境客户出具持续经营意见的倾向为衡量指标）之间的关系，并分析不同合伙人群体（薪酬分布低端、男性、早期职业者）的异质性效应。
AI.findings: 1) 四大审计公司内更大的薪酬差距与对困境客户出具持续经营意见的倾向降低相关；2) 这种负面影响在薪酬分布低端的合伙人、男性审计师和早期职业者中更明显；3) 只有无法解释的薪酬差距与审计质量下降相关；4) 合伙人相对薪酬排名上升会缓解负面影响，而排名下降会加剧负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为专业合伙制中薪酬差距的绩效后果提供了新证据；2) 支持公平理论而非锦标赛激励理论在审计合伙制中的适用性；3) 揭示了相对薪酬排名动态变化对绩效的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 对审计公司：需要重新考虑薪酬结构设计，平衡激励与公平；2) 对监管机构：关注薪酬差距对审计质量的影响，可能需要对薪酬透明度提出要求；3) 对资本市场参与者：理解审计质量可能受到合伙人薪酬结构的影响。

title: Elevating Trust in High-Stakes Decisions Using Glass-Box Models and Robust Feature Selection
affiliations: Leibniz  Universität Hannover - Institute for Risk and Insurance, Leibniz  Universität Hannover - Institute for Risk and Insurance and Leibniz  Universität Hannover - Institute for Risk and Insurance

detail.title: Elevating Trust in High-Stakes Decisions Using Glass-Box Models and Robust Feature Selection
detail.abstract: We provide a unified framework that jointly leverages a robust selection procedure and a highcapacity, additive neural architecture. We test this framework on a public and a large-scale proprietary insurance dataset. Our results show that this approach allows the Neural Additive Model (NAM) to outperform traditional glass-box models in predictive accuracy. Moreover, compared to benchmark black-box models, the framework proves to be a robust and transparent alternative. We also use a market simulation study on the proprietary data set which demonstrates that the suggested framework achieves superior economic outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个结合鲁棒选择程序和高容量加性神经架构的统一框架，在保险数据集上验证了其预测准确性和经济价值，为可解释AI提供了透明且高性能的替代方案。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个既保持高预测准确性又具备透明可解释性的机器学习框架，使其在保险等高风险决策领域能够超越传统玻璃盒模型并与黑盒模型竞争？
AI.motivation: 在保险等高风险决策领域，传统玻璃盒模型（如线性回归）虽然可解释但预测能力有限，而黑盒模型（如深度神经网络）虽然预测准确但缺乏透明度。需要开发一种既能保持高预测性能又具备可解释性的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于神经加性模型（NAM）的理论框架，结合鲁棒特征选择程序和高容量加性神经架构，构建了一个统一的可解释AI框架。
AI.method: 1. 在公开数据集和大规模专有保险数据集上进行测试；2. 使用神经加性模型（NAM）架构；3. 采用鲁棒的特征选择程序；4. 进行市场模拟研究评估经济效果；5. 与传统玻璃盒模型和基准黑盒模型进行比较。
AI.findings: 1. NAM框架在预测准确性上超越了传统玻璃盒模型；2. 与基准黑盒模型相比，该框架提供了鲁棒且透明的替代方案；3. 在专有数据集的市场模拟中，该框架实现了更优越的经济结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个统一的可解释AI框架，将鲁棒选择程序与高容量加性神经架构相结合；2. 扩展了神经加性模型在现实世界高风险决策领域的应用理论；3. 为透明机器学习模型的设计提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为保险行业提供了既准确又可解释的预测工具；2. 通过市场模拟证明了该框架的经济价值；3. 为其他高风险决策领域（如金融、医疗）的可解释AI应用提供了实践参考。

title: Tail market linkage between Canadian banks and non-bank financial intermediaries
affiliations: Government of Canada - Bank of Canada

detail.title: Tail market linkage between Canadian banks and non-bank financial intermediaries
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes market-based connections between Canadian banks and non-bank financial institutions during periods of stress. Using weekly equity data from 1990-2024, I find an increase in the perceived interconnections between Canadian banks and NBFIs in the period leading up to the COVID-19 pandemic and stabilized after. After policy measures were taken to control the liquidity issue of Home Trust, during 2017, the systemic risk spillovers from mortgage firms to the banking sector decreased. Tail dependence with NBFIs is stronger for larger banks, emphasizing their central role in the financial system. Overall, the findings highlight the growing importance of the bank–NBFI nexus for financial stability monitoring and the usefulness of market-based tail risk measures for tracking systemic vulnerabilities in real time.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用1990-2024年周度股票数据分析加拿大银行与非银行金融机构在市场压力时期的关联性，发现COVID-19疫情前银行与NBFI的感知关联性增强，2017年Home Trust流动性问题政策干预后抵押贷款公司向银行部门的系统性风险溢出减少，大型银行与NBFI的尾部依赖性更强。
AI.research_question: 加拿大银行与非银行金融机构在市场压力时期的市场关联性如何变化？政策干预如何影响系统性风险溢出？不同规模银行的尾部依赖性有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着金融体系复杂化，银行与非银行金融机构之间的关联性对金融稳定性的影响日益重要，需要实时监测系统性风险，特别是在压力时期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险理论、尾部依赖性理论、金融网络关联性理论、市场风险溢出理论。
AI.method: 使用1990-2024年周度股票数据，采用市场基础的尾部风险度量方法，分析银行与NBFI之间的关联性和风险溢出效应。
AI.findings: 1. COVID-19疫情前银行与NBFI的感知关联性增强，疫情后趋于稳定；2. 2017年Home Trust流动性问题政策干预后，抵押贷款公司向银行部门的系统性风险溢出减少；3. 大型银行与NBFI的尾部依赖性更强，凸显其在金融系统中的核心作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对银行-NBFI关联性动态变化的理解；2. 验证了市场基础的尾部风险度量在实时监测系统性脆弱性中的有效性；3. 为金融网络关联性理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融监管机构提供实时监测系统性风险的工具；2. 强调关注大型银行与NBFI关联性的重要性；3. 证明政策干预在控制风险溢出方面的有效性；4. 为金融稳定性监测提供实证依据。

title: Targeting Higher Credit Card Payments
affiliations: Rice University - Jesse H. Jones Graduate School of Business

detail.title: Targeting Higher Credit Card Payments
detail.abstract: In a field experiment, I test two nudges in a credit card payment app: shrouding the credit card minimum payment amount and an option to pay 50% of the statement balance. After six statements, neither nudge increases credit card payments. This shows that evidence from online experiments–that finds increases in hypothetical credit card payments from shrouding the minimum payment–does not extrapolate to the field. My results demonstrate that the minimum payment does not act as an anchor that lowers cardholders' payments. Instead, cardholders frequently lack liquid cash and target paying at least the minimum payment, which acts as a reference point.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实地实验测试了两种信用卡支付助推策略（隐藏最低还款额和提供支付50%账单余额选项），发现六期账单后两种策略均未增加实际信用卡还款额，表明在线实验中的假设性支付增加效应无法外推到真实场景。
AI.research_question: 在信用卡支付应用中，隐藏最低还款额和提供支付50%账单余额选项这两种助推策略能否实际增加信用卡还款额？在线实验中的发现能否外推到真实支付行为？
AI.motivation: 先前在线实验发现隐藏最低还款额能增加假设性信用卡支付，但缺乏实地验证。需要检验这些助推策略在真实支付环境中的有效性，以及最低还款额是否真的作为锚点影响支付行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 锚定效应理论（最低还款额作为锚点降低支付）、参考点理论（最低还款额作为参考点）、助推理论（通过设计选择架构影响行为）、行为经济学中的支付行为理论。
AI.method: 实地实验方法，在信用卡支付应用中随机分配用户到不同助推条件组，跟踪六期账单的实际支付行为，比较隐藏最低还款额组、提供50%支付选项组与对照组的支付差异。
AI.findings: 两种助推策略均未显著增加实际信用卡还款额；最低还款额并非降低支付的锚点，而是作为持卡人的参考点；持卡人经常缺乏流动资金，目标只是支付至少最低还款额。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了最低还款额作为锚定效应的传统观点，提出参考点理论解释；揭示了在线实验与实地实验结果的差异，强调行为干预的外部效度验证的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信用卡公司和金融科技公司提供实证证据：简单的界面助推可能无效；需要更深入理解持卡人的流动性约束；设计干预时应考虑真实支付环境的复杂性。

title: Lasting Impact of Stay-at-Home Orders on Municipal Solid Waste Generation During and After the Pandemic
affiliations: Faculty of Economics, Kindai University, University of Toyama - Center for Far Eastern Studies and Okayama University

detail.title: Lasting Impact of Stay-at-Home Orders on Municipal Solid Waste Generation During and After the Pandemic
detail.abstract: This study estimates the impact of stay-at-home (SAH) orders on municipal solid waste (MSW) generation and examines whether these effects persisted after restrictions ended. Using an original dataset of monthly MSW collected from households and retail stores across 1,419 Japanese municipalities and a difference-in-differences (DID) design, we identify dynamic and heterogeneous effects by waste type and municipal characteristics. We find that although aggregate MSW generation decreased due to the pandemic, municipalities under SAH orders experienced an average 1.9%–2.1% increase in per capita MSW generation. Moreover, in municipalities with longer cumulative SAH exposure, MSW generation remained 1.6%–1.9% higher even after the final orders were lifted. We also find a persistent rise in recyclable waste generation, especially in municipalities with higher shares of students and IT workers. These findings highlight that shifts in time use towards the home may have long-term implications for waste generation patterns and municipal service provision in the post-SAH period.

AI.tldr: 日本研究发现，居家令导致人均生活垃圾增加1.9%-2.1%，即使禁令解除后，暴露时间较长的城市垃圾量仍高出1.6%-1.9%，可回收垃圾持续增加，特别是学生和IT工作者比例高的城市。
AI.research_question: 居家令对城市生活垃圾产生的影响是什么？这些影响在限制结束后是否持续存在？
AI.motivation: 了解COVID-19大流行期间居家令对生活垃圾产生模式的动态和异质性影响，以及这些变化是否具有长期性，对城市服务规划和环境政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时间使用理论和家庭生产理论，居家令改变了人们的时间分配和家庭活动模式，从而影响垃圾产生行为。
AI.method: 使用日本1,419个城市的月度生活垃圾收集原始数据集，采用双重差分法设计，分析不同垃圾类型和城市特征的动态异质性效应。
AI.findings: 1. 虽然大流行期间总垃圾量减少，但居家令城市人均垃圾增加1.9%-2.1%；2. 居家令暴露时间长的城市，禁令解除后垃圾量仍高出1.6%-1.9%；3. 可回收垃圾持续增加，特别是在学生和IT工作者比例高的城市。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了时间使用理论在环境行为研究中的应用，揭示了居家时间增加对垃圾产生模式的长期影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市垃圾管理服务规划提供实证依据，帮助政策制定者预测后疫情时代的垃圾产生模式变化，优化资源分配和服务提供。

detail.abstract: In recent years, the world has witnessed a significant backlash against globalization. However, Japan is a puzzling outlier: while it shares many characteristics with countries like the United States and the United Kingdom that are experiencing waves of populism and protectionism, it has not followed their trajectory. Indeed, although it was often criticized during the post-World War II period for its slow trade liberalization, Japan has made a striking transition from a laggard to a leader on trade issues. Why has Japan attempted to counter anti-globalization forces in the international system, and how has it sought to do so? This chapter addresses these questions through an examination of Japanese politics and foreign policy, with particular attention to the period after the Brexit referendum and the election of Donald Trump in 2016 until the end of the Trump administration in January 2021. It argues that due to a combination of external and internal factors, Japanese policymakers have recognized the importance of the liberal international economic order for their national interests, and importantly, Japanese leaders have had the flexibility to defend this order because their country has not experienced widespread domestic protectionism or anti-global populism. Consequently, Japan has attempted to bolster trade institutions, rules, and norms through a mix of five strategies: 1) direct persuasion, 2) signaling commitment, 3) acting as a US surrogate, 4) negotiating new trade agreements, and 5) supporting existing institutions.

AI.tldr: 日本在全球反全球化浪潮中成为例外，从贸易自由化落后者转变为领导者，通过五种策略维护自由国际经济秩序。
AI.research_question: 为什么日本试图在国际体系中对抗反全球化力量，以及它如何试图这样做？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内出现显著的反全球化反弹，但日本却是一个令人困惑的例外。尽管日本与美国、英国等经历民粹主义和保护主义浪潮的国家有许多共同特征，但日本并未遵循它们的轨迹，反而从贸易自由化的落后者转变为领导者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际政治经济学、自由主义国际秩序理论、国内政治与外交政策互动理论。
AI.method: 通过对日本政治和外交政策的考察，特别关注2016年英国脱欧公投和特朗普当选至2021年特朗普政府结束期间的时期。
AI.findings: 由于外部和内部因素的综合作用，日本政策制定者认识到自由国际经济秩序对其国家利益的重要性，且日本领导人具有灵活性来维护这一秩序，因为日本国内没有经历广泛的保护主义或反全球化民粹主义。因此，日本通过五种策略来加强贸易制度、规则和规范。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了理解国家在全球反全球化浪潮中不同反应的理论框架，强调了国内政治条件在塑造国家对外经济政策中的关键作用，丰富了国内-国际政治互动理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他国家如何应对反全球化挑战提供了政策启示，展示了日本通过五种具体策略维护国际经济秩序的实际做法，为国际社会维护多边贸易体系提供了参考案例。

detail.abstract:
The International Refugee Protection Regime (IRPR), anchored by the 1951 Convention and its 1967 Protocol, is currently facing an unprecedented existential challenge. While the traditional architecture relies on the individualized Refugee Status Determination (RSD) to grant durable legal standing, the mass displacement triggered by Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine has exposed the systemic obsolescence of this model in the face of large-scale, protracted aggression.

In a decisive move, the European Union activated its long-dormant Temporary Protection Directive (2001/55/EC), providing immediate sanctuary to over 4.3 million individuals. Simultaneously, the United States leveraged humanitarian parole through the Uniting for Ukraine (U4U) program, which, until its suspension by Executive Order in January 2025, served as a primary, albeit precarious, entry point for approximately 270,000 beneficiaries.

Despite the operational success of these group-based mechanisms in preventing immediate humanitarian catastrophe, they have inadvertently institutionalized a state of "indefinite temporariness". This article argues that we are witnessing the emergence of a new legal phenomenon — “protracted temporaries”. This category encompasses individuals who remain de facto integrated into host societies while being trapped in a de jure vacuum, devoid of any predictable pathway to permanent residency or international protection. Through a comparative lens, this study dissects the structural flaws of both the EU and U.S. models, advocating for a radical shift toward integration-based legal stabilization.

This study is uniquely informed by my professional experience as the UHP Program Coordinator at Della Lamb Community Services in Kansas City, Missouri. Since 2023, I have directly managed the resettlement and support of over 100 Ukrainian households. These longitudinal observations from the field provide a necessary empirical bridge between high-level policy analysis and the lived reality of legal precarity. By integrating practitioner-based insights with a comparative legal framework, this article aims to ground theoretical arguments in the practical challenges of sustaining integration under conditions of protracted displacement.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨国际难民保护制度在应对大规模流离失所时的系统性失效，分析欧盟临时保护指令和美国"团结为乌克兰"计划如何导致"无限期临时性"状态，提出"长期临时身份"这一新法律现象，并主张向基于融合的法律稳定化转型。

AI.motivation: 国际难民保护制度基于个体难民身份认定的传统模式在面对大规模、长期性侵略时已显过时，欧盟和美国采用的临时保护机制虽然避免了人道主义灾难，却使难民陷入"无限期临时性"的法律真空状态，缺乏获得永久居留权或国际保护的可预测途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际难民保护制度理论、临时保护机制理论、法律身份理论、融合理论、比较法律分析框架。
AI.method: 比较法律分析（欧盟临时保护指令与美国"团结为乌克兰"计划）、基于实践者经验的实证观察（作者作为密苏里州堪萨斯城Della Lamb社区服务UHP项目协调员的田野工作经验）、理论分析与实证数据结合的方法。
AI.findings: 1. 欧盟和美国的大规模保护机制虽然操作上成功，但导致了"长期临时身份"这一新法律现象；2. 难民在事实上融入东道国社会，但在法律上处于真空状态；3. 两种模式都存在结构性缺陷；4. 需要从临时保护转向基于融合的法律稳定化。

title: Ce modèle vous plaît? Semi-parametric Preference Estimation and Socially Optimal Routing Policies for Large Language Models
affiliations: UC Santa Barbara

detail.title: Ce modèle vous plaît? Semi-parametric Preference Estimation and Socially Optimal Routing Policies for Large Language Models
detail.abstract: Large language models are increasingly embedded in production systems across a wide range of applications, making model selection and routing an important economic challenge as AI adoption scales. Models differ substantially in output quality and inference costs, yet prevailing evaluation practices rely on global rankings that obscure contextual heterogeneity and offer limited guidance for task-specific deployment. This paper develops a semiparametric structural framework to estimate heterogeneous preference measures and inference costs from pairwise LLM evaluation experiments, and embeds the resulting heterogeneity-enriched parameters into a social planner's routing problem. The framework extends the Bradley-Terry model by allowing preferences to vary flexibly with prompt embeddings and other contextual features, supports valid statistical inference through Neyman-orthogonal estimators implemented with deep learning, and accommodates nested choice structures as well as revealed indifference through ties. Applied to data from the French government's Compar:IA platform, the estimated model yields cost-aware deployment policies that reduce expected energy use by 80 percent relative to ranking-based rules, without lowering the probability of selecting the model most preferred by humans for a given task.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个半参数结构框架，通过成对LLM评估实验估计异质性偏好和推理成本，并将结果嵌入社会规划者的路由问题中。应用显示，该方法相比基于排名的规则能减少80%的预期能耗，同时不降低选择人类偏好模型的可能性。
AI.research_question: 如何在大语言模型部署中，通过考虑上下文异质性和推理成本，开发一个有效的模型选择和路由框架来优化资源分配？
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在生产系统中的广泛应用，模型选择和路由成为重要的经济挑战。现有评估实践依赖全局排名，忽略了上下文异质性，无法为特定任务部署提供有效指导。模型在输出质量和推理成本方面存在显著差异，需要更精细的决策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展Bradley-Terry模型，允许偏好随提示嵌入和其他上下文特征灵活变化；采用半参数结构框架估计异质性偏好和推理成本；使用Neyman-正交估计器支持有效统计推断；处理嵌套选择结构和通过平局揭示的偏好无差异。
AI.method: 基于成对LLM评估实验数据，使用深度学习实现的Neyman-正交估计器估计异质性偏好参数和推理成本；将估计参数嵌入社会规划者的路由问题中；在法国政府Compar:IA平台数据上进行实证应用。
AI.findings: 估计模型产生的成本感知部署策略，相比基于排名的规则，预期能耗减少80%，同时不降低为给定任务选择人类最偏好模型的概率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展Bradley-Terry模型以处理上下文异质性；2) 开发半参数结构框架估计异质性偏好和成本；3) 引入Neyman-正交估计器支持有效推断；4) 处理嵌套选择和偏好无差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供成本感知的LLM部署决策框架；2) 显著降低能耗（80%）；3) 保持人类偏好选择质量；4) 为AI系统资源优化提供实用工具；5) 在政府平台验证有效性。

title: Spatial Vulnerability Reversal in Self-Organizing Systems: Core Interior is More Fragile than Boundary
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Spatial Vulnerability Reversal in Self-Organizing Systems: Core Interior is More Fragile than Boundary
detail.abstract: Boundary-driven self-organizing systems are widely studied across physics, biology, and artificial life, yet the spatial distribution of structural vulnerability within such systems remains poorly understood. Prior work suggested that boundary regions-being interfaces between the system and its environment-constitute the primary locus of fragility. Here we challenge this intuition through a policy-free counterfactual intervention study in boundary-driven cellular automata. Across 50 seeds and 100 snapshots per seed (N =5,000 measurements per condition), we find that core-interior interventions (localized perturbations at distance ≥2 cells from the boundary) produce a 2.14-fold higher collapse rate (28.9% vs 12.9% baseline, p<10-4 , Cohen's d≈-0.47) compared to boundary-targeted interventions (13.5%, statistically indistinguishable from baseline, p=0.41). This spatial vulnerability persists under alive-cell matching (core-interior: 30.0% vs boundary: 14.3%, ratio 2.10×, p<10-4), ruling out density artifacts. Mechanistic analysis reveals dynamic fragility: a sharp spatial transition at d≈60 separates a frozen periphery (0 turnover events) from a dynamic core (9,574 events in 1,000 snapshots). Core coherence is maintained through constant cell-level adjustments-a dynamically sustained equilibrium disrupted by perturbations. We propose this as a general principle and provide six testable predictions across computational (reaction-diffusion, flocking, Voronoi CA) and biological (biofilms, epithelial morphogenesis, swarm robotics) systems. If validated, the Core-Boundary Fragility Principle inverts conventional design intuitions: robustness requires protecting dynamic interiors, not static boundaries. Our counterfactual methodology provides a template for localizing vulnerability in complex dynamical systems.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文挑战了传统观点，发现边界驱动的自组织系统中，核心内部区域比边界区域更脆弱，提出了"核心-边界脆弱性原理"。
AI.research_question: 边界驱动的自组织系统中，结构脆弱性的空间分布特征是什么？核心区域是否比边界区域更脆弱？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为边界区域是系统脆弱性的主要位置，但这一直觉缺乏实证支持。需要理解自组织系统中脆弱性的真实空间分布特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边界驱动的自组织系统理论、细胞自动机理论、复杂系统脆弱性理论
AI.method: 采用无策略反事实干预研究，在边界驱动的细胞自动机中进行实验。使用50个种子和每个种子100个快照（每个条件N=5,000个测量），比较核心内部干预（距离边界≥2个细胞）和边界目标干预的效果。
AI.findings: 1. 核心内部干预导致系统崩溃率比边界干预高2.14倍（28.9% vs 13.5%）；2. 空间脆弱性在活细胞匹配条件下仍然存在；3. 动态脆弱性分析显示在距离d≈60处存在空间转变，将冻结的外围与动态核心分开；4. 核心一致性通过持续的细胞级调整维持，形成动态平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"核心-边界脆弱性原理"，挑战了传统设计直觉；提供了六个可测试的预测；建立了反事实方法论模板，用于定位复杂动态系统中的脆弱性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂系统设计提供了新指导：鲁棒性需要保护动态内部而非静态边界；方法论可应用于计算系统（反应扩散、群体行为、Voronoi CA）和生物系统（生物膜、上皮形态发生、群体机器人）。

title: Reimagining Python's Tooling: The Transition from Pip to Uv
affiliations: Dhaka Residential Model College, Jahangirnagar University - Department of CSE and Cumilla Shikkha Board Government Model College

detail.title: Reimagining Python's Tooling: The Transition from Pip to Uv
detail.abstract: The Python ecosystem is undergoing a profound and accelerated transformation, moving beyond its foundational syntax and libraries to a modern, integrated, and high-performance tooling landscape. For years, the standard toolchain, built on pip and virtualenv, served the community adequately but was often criticized for its speed, dependency resolution complexities, and lack of a unified project management experience. This article chronicles this pivotal shift, arguing that the advent of Rustpowered tools like uv, ruff, and pdm represents a fundamental modernization of the Python developer experience. We will explore the limitations of the traditional toolchain that created the demand for change, analyzing specific pain points in dependency management, virtual environment handling, and linting performance. The core of the discussion focuses on the new generation of tools, examining how their design philosophy prioritizes blistering speed, robust correctness, and seamless user ergonomics. By tracing this evolution from the established pip/venv workflow to the emerging, cohesive toolstack led by uv, this article demonstrates how these innovations are not merely incremental upgrades but a paradigm shift. This transformation is crucial for Python's continued relevance, enabling developers to build, manage, and scale projects with an efficiency and reliability previously unseen in the ecosystem, thereby solidifying Python's position in the face of modern software development demands.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了Python生态系统从传统pip/virtualenv工具链向基于Rust的新一代工具（如uv、ruff、pdm）的范式转变，分析了传统工具的局限性以及新工具在速度、依赖管理和用户体验方面的创新。
AI.research_question: Python生态系统如何从传统的pip/virtualenv工具链转变为基于Rust的现代化工具生态系统？这种转变对Python开发者的体验和生态系统的未来发展有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统Python工具链（pip和virtualenv）存在速度慢、依赖解析复杂、缺乏统一项目管理体验等问题，已无法满足现代软件开发的需求，促使生态系统向高性能、集成化的工具转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术生态系统演化理论、工具链现代化理论、开发者体验优化理论、编程语言生态系统可持续发展理论。
AI.method: 采用历史分析法和比较分析法，通过分析传统工具链的局限性，对比新一代工具的设计理念和性能特点，论证Python工具生态系统的范式转变。
AI.findings: 基于Rust的新一代工具（uv、ruff、pdm）在速度、依赖解析正确性和用户体验方面显著优于传统工具，代表了Python工具生态系统的根本性现代化，而不仅仅是渐进式改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Python工具生态系统范式转变的理论框架，阐述了从传统工具链向现代化、高性能工具栈演化的必然性和重要性，为编程语言生态系统演化研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Python开发者提供了现代化工具选择的指导，展示了如何通过采用新工具提升开发效率和项目可维护性，为Python生态系统保持竞争力提供了实践路径。

title: Scale Invariant Dynamics in Market Price Momentum
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Scale Invariant Dynamics in Market Price Momentum
detail.abstract: We analyze E-mini S&P 500 (ES) futures using phase space methods, constructing a two-dimensional representation from price momentum and its rate of change. Applying sparse identication of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) to 15 years of minute-level data, we nd that momentum dynamics at intraday-to-daily timescales follow a stochastic damped harmonic oscillator (SDHO), a structure that emerges from the data rather than by a priori assumption. Three dimensionless quantities characterize these dynamics: dissipation rate Ω ≈ 0.92, deterministic fraction R 2 ≈ 0.57, and scaled restoring force Φ (market-specic). Cross-market analysis of six major futures (ES, NQ, CL, GC, ZB, 6E) reveals that Ω and R 2 are stable across all markets (CV < 2%), while Φ varies by asset class (CV ≈ 103%), encoding market-specic information about mean-reversion intensity. We connect these ndings to Liouville's theorem, information geometry, and contact geometry for dissipative systems. At weekly and longer horizons, preliminary analysis indicates a transition to nonlinear dynamics; the detailed characterization of this regime is developed in a companion paper (Dean, 2026). Notes: We use stable in the empirical sense of consistency across timescales, markets, and coordinate choices, not as a claim of mathematical invariance. The reported R 2 reects conditional variance of momentum acceleration, not return predictability or tradable alpha. The coecient of variation (CV = standard deviation / mean × 100%) measures relative dispersion. (v2: Corrected CL values in Table 2)

AI.tldr: 该研究使用相空间方法和稀疏识别非线性动力学(SINDy)分析E-mini S&P 500期货，发现日内到日间时间尺度的动量动态遵循随机阻尼谐振子(SDHO)模型，该结构从数据中自然涌现而非先验假设。跨市场分析显示两个关键参数在六个主要期货市场中保持稳定，而第三个参数随资产类别变化，编码了市场特定的均值回归强度信息。
AI.research_question: 金融市场动量动态在相空间中的基本结构是什么？这些动态是否遵循可识别的数学模式？不同市场间的动量动态是否存在共性特征？
AI.motivation: 传统金融模型通常基于先验假设构建，缺乏从数据中自然涌现的结构。研究旨在通过相空间方法和稀疏识别技术，直接从高频数据中发现金融市场动量动态的内在数学结构，理解不同市场间的共性和差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相空间理论、稀疏识别非线性动力学(SINDy)、随机阻尼谐振子(SDHO)、Liouville定理、信息几何、耗散系统接触几何
AI.method: 使用15年的分钟级E-mini S&P 500期货数据，构建基于价格动量及其变化率的二维相空间表示。应用SINDy方法识别动量动态的数学结构。对六个主要期货市场(ES, NQ, CL, GC, ZB, 6E)进行跨市场比较分析。
AI.findings:
1. 日内到日间时间尺度的动量动态遵循随机阻尼谐振子(SDHO)模型
2. 三个无量纲参数：耗散率Ω≈0.92，确定性分数R²≈0.57，缩放恢复力Φ(市场特定)
3. Ω和R²在所有六个市场中保持稳定(CV<2%)，而Φ随资产类别变化(CV≈103%)
4. 周度及以上时间尺度显示向非线性动态的转变
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次从数据中自然涌现出随机阻尼谐振子作为金融市场动量动态的基本结构
2. 建立了金融市场动态与Liouville定理、信息几何和接触几何的理论联系
3. 识别了跨市场稳定的动态参数和资产类别特定的参数
4. 为理解不同时间尺度下的动态转变提供了理论基础
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供了量化市场动量动态的标准化框架
2. 识别了跨市场稳定的参数，可用于市场状态监测
3. 市场特定的Φ参数可作为均值回归强度的量化指标
4. 为高频交易策略和风险管理提供了新的分析工具

detail.title: Urban–rural inequality and over-grading in Romanian schools
detail.abstract: This study examines whether Romania’s urban – rural divide might pressure rural teachers to assign passing grades to failing students and urban teachers to assign very high grades to less proficient students. The analysis of the 2023 National Evaluation population data revealed strong overall correlations between school grades and test scores, while test scores averaged nearly three points below grades in rural areas and two points below in urban areas. Quantile mixed-effects models demonstrated a fan-out pattern of the test score conditional quantiles in rural schools, indicating widespread over-grading: passing and even average grades were assigned to very unprepared students, while high grades were inconsistently calibrated. In contrast, urban schools, particularly elite institutions, displayed a fan-in pattern, with stronger grade – score relationships at the lower quantiles and weaker relationships at the top, a pattern consistent with ceiling at the top and over-grading at the bottom of narrow high-grade bands.

title: Sustainable Energy Supply and Economi̇c Growth In Türki̇ye: Ardl and AI-based Forecasting Analysis (1990–2024)

detail.title: Sustainable Energy Supply and Economi̇c Growth In Türki̇ye: Ardl and AI-based Forecasting Analysis (1990–2024)
detail.abstract: This study investigates the dynamic relationships between sustainable energy supply, electricity usage, trade openness, foreign direct investment (FDI), greenhouse gas emissions, and economic growth in Turkey over the period 1990–2024. Using Python-based econometric analyses including Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) unit root tests, ARDL bounds testing, Error Correction Models (ECM), and Granger causality, we identify both long-run cointegration and short-run causal links among the variables. Results reveal that sustainable energy supply and electricity consumption significantly contribute to long-term economic growth, while trade openness and FDI provide both short-term and long-term growth effects. Environmental degradation, measured by total greenhouse gas emissions per capita, negatively affects growth, highlighting the trade-off between development and sustainability. Furthermore, AI-based forecasting models indicate that GDP and energy demand are projected to continue growing through 2030, emphasizing the importance of sustainable energy policies. These findings are consistent with Neoclassical and Endogenous Growth theories and provide empirical support for the Environmental Kuznets Curve hypothesis in the Turkish context. The study offers critical insights for policymakers aiming to balance economic growth with sustainable energy supply and environmental sustainability.

title: Returns-to-Scale and Manager Skill in US Bond Funds
affiliations: and Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge - E.J. Ourso College of Business Administration

detail.title: Returns-to-Scale and Manager Skill in US Bond Funds
detail.abstract: This paper examines corporate bond mutual funds to explore the relation between fund size and performance and the relation between fund size and manager skill. We find a significantly negative relation between fund size and performance that is robust to various empirical specifications. Using several proxy variables we find that the negative effect of scale on performance is not related to illiquidity effects, but we do find support for the limited attention hypothesis. Accounting for the adverse effect of size on performance, we quantify fund manager skill. Using the skill measure introduced by Berk and van Binsbergen (2015) the average bond fund manager in our sample generates nearly $5 million dollars in annual wealth.

detail.title: Mind over Matter? The Human Capital-Innovation Gap in Regional Disparities in Poland

publicationDetails.detailsText: Paper was accepted by Journal of Intellectual Capital on Sep, 25th 2025.  AAM is deposited under the Creative Commons Attribution Non-commercial International Licence 4.0 (CC BY-NC 4.0).

detail.abstract: Study investigates the complex interplay between human capital and innovation in shaping regional economic development, with a particular focus on persistent disparities across Polish regions. While prior research has established a general link between human capital and innovation, there remains a significant gap in understanding how this relationship manifests under varying institutional, historical, and socio-economic conditions, especially in post-transition and emerging economies, in the context of the latest economic and technological shifts like post-COVID recovery, digital transformation, and green economy initiatives. The aim is to uncover the mechanisms that either facilitate or hinder the translation of educational and workforce assets into regional innovation outcomes and to propose targeted, region-specific policy interventions.a quantitative methodology, this study utilizes the Mazziotta-Pareto Index to develop composite indices for human capital and innovation. These indices are applied to 16 Polish regions, analyzed over 15 years (2009â€“2023). Data from Statistics Poland and Eurostat were standardized and aggregated to create comparative rankings. The analysis includes correlation assessments and regional rankings to identify patterns of divergence between human capital development and innovation output.results reveal significant regional disparities in Poland's human capital-innovation relationship. Some regions show strong alignment (e.g., Mazowieckie, MaÅ‚opolskie), others possess high human capital but low innovation (e.g., Lubelskie, Podlaskie), while a few combine low human capital with high innovation (e.g., Podkarpacie). These mismatches are shaped by structural economic conditions, industrial specialization, and institutional quality. Findings suggest that enhancing institutional support and industry-academia linkages is critical for converting educational assets into innovation capacity. Targeted policy measures are needed to boost innovation absorption in human capital-rich regions and stimulate human capital development in innovative but skill-deficient areas

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了波兰各地区人力资本与创新之间的复杂关系，揭示了显著的区域差异。研究发现，一些地区人力资本与创新高度匹配，而另一些地区则存在人力资本高但创新低或人力资本低但创新高的不匹配现象。这些差异受结构性经济条件、产业专业化和制度质量影响。

title: The Militia II: Armed Self-Defense, the Second Amendment, and the Citizen
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Militia II: Armed Self-Defense, the Second Amendment, and the Citizen
detail.abstract: The United States Supreme Court’s decision in Heller was in error. The Court continued this error through Bruen. Though the Court decided correctly that individuals have a constitutional and inalienable right to armed self-defense inside (and now outside) the home, the Court incorrectly described the right as the Second Amendment’s core area of protection. On the contrary, the individual right to armed self-defense exists independent of the Second Amendment, and the Second Amendment’s core area of protection is the individual right to own privately and keep weapons suitable for militia service. Federal courts have approached both the individual right to armed self-defense and the Second Amendment incorrectly. This has led to a confused Second Amendment jurisprudence. Federal courts should move away from viewing the Second Amendment as a codification of the individual right to self-defense. They should recognize an unenumerated “original right”—the individual right to armed self-defense, and they should recognize the Second Amendment’s protection of an individual right to keep weapons suitable for militia service. Doing so will clear up the confusion and contradiction that defines current Second Amendment, self-defense, and militia jurisprudence.

AI.tldr: 本文认为美国最高法院在Heller案和Bruen案中的判决存在错误，错误地将第二修正案的核心保护范围界定为个人武装自卫权。作者主张个人武装自卫权是独立于第二修正案的"原始权利"，而第二修正案真正保护的是个人拥有适合民兵服务的武器的权利。

title: Anthropization and the rising burden of leprosy in Senegal: rethinking human–environment interactions
affiliations: Aix-Marseille University, Aix-Marseille University and Aix-Marseille University - IHU - Mediterranean Infection

detail.title: Anthropization and the rising burden of leprosy in Senegal: rethinking human–environment interactions
detail.abstract: Despite official elimination in 1995, Senegal has experienced leprosy resurgence, particularly lepromatous forms, potentially linked to anthropogenic environmental changes. This study investigates associations between anthropization activities and leprosy case distribution across Senegal's regions. We conducted ecological analysis using leprosy surveillance data from 14 villages, including 2020 registered cases and newly detected cases (2020-2022) from active case-finding in Social Rehabilitation Villages. Agricultural activities were classified using five zones and intensity scoring (0-4). Mining activity was categorized as high, medium, low, or no activity. Statistical analyses included correlation analysis, ANOVA, and linear regression. A strong positive correlations were observed between agricultural intensity and leprosy cases (Spearman's ρ = 0.758, p = 0.002). Very high intensity regions showed 371.5 mean cases versus 10.8 in low intensity regions. Each agricultural intensity unit increase corresponded to 63.84 additional cases (p = 0.004, R² = 0.515). Bassin Arachidier accounted for 65.2% of cases despite representing three of fourteen regions. Mining activity showed moderate correlation (ρ = 0.647, p = 0.012), with high activity regions having significantly more cases than low activity regions (208.3 vs. 14.2, p = 0.038). This analysis reveals significant associations between anthropization, particularly intensive agriculture and mining and leprosy distribution in Senegal. Environmental disruption may create conditions conducive to Mycobacterium leprae transmission. Results parallel to Buruli ulcer associations, supporting shared environmental transmission pathways for mycobacterial diseases. Despite cross-sectional limitations, findings warrant investigation and may inform targeted surveillance in high-risk settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现塞内加尔麻风病病例分布与人类活动（特别是集约化农业和采矿）显著相关，农业强度每增加一个单位对应增加63.84个病例，采矿活动强度高的地区病例数显著更高。
AI.research_question: 塞内加尔的人类活动（特别是农业和采矿）与麻风病病例分布之间是否存在关联？
AI.motivation: 尽管塞内加尔在1995年宣布消除麻风病，但近年来特别是瘤型麻风病出现反弹，可能与人类活动导致的环境变化有关，需要研究这种关联以指导防控策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境流行病学理论，人类活动改变环境可能影响麻风分枝杆菌的传播途径；与布鲁里溃疡病类似的共同环境传播途径假设。
AI.method: 生态学分析，使用14个村庄的麻风病监测数据（2020年登记病例和2020-2022年新发现病例），农业活动按5个区域和强度评分（0-4）分类，采矿活动按高、中、低、无分类，统计方法包括相关性分析、ANOVA和线性回归。
AI.findings: 农业强度与麻风病病例呈强正相关（Spearman's ρ = 0.758, p = 0.002），极高强度地区平均371.5例，低强度地区10.8例；农业强度每增加一个单位对应增加63.84个病例（p = 0.004, R² = 0.515）；采矿活动呈中等相关（ρ = 0.647, p = 0.012），高强度地区病例显著多于低强度地区（208.3 vs. 14.2, p = 0.038）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为麻风病环境传播理论提供实证支持，揭示人类活动（特别是集约化农业和采矿）可能通过环境破坏创造有利于麻风分枝杆菌传播的条件；与布鲁里溃疡病的相似关联支持分枝杆菌疾病共享环境传播途径的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别高风险区域（如Bassin Arachidier地区占病例65.2%），为针对性监测和防控提供依据；建议在农业和采矿活动密集地区加强麻风病监测；为塞内加尔及其他类似环境国家的麻风病防控策略提供参考。
